# Remover Metadados — Full LLM Documentation

## Overview

**Remover Metadados** (Portuguese) / **Metadata Remover** (English) is a free, open-source, browser-based tool that lets users permanently strip metadata from their files without ever uploading them to a server.

The site serves two audiences:
1. **Brazilian users** at `https://remover-metadados.com/` (Portuguese, pt-BR)
2. **International / English-speaking users** at `https://remover-metadados.com/en/`

---

## What is Metadata?

Metadata is hidden information embedded inside files that can expose sensitive details:

- **EXIF data in photos**: GPS coordinates (exact location where the photo was taken), camera model, serial number, date and time, lens settings (f-stop, shutter speed, ISO), software used to edit the image.
- **IPTC/XMP in images**: Author name, copyright notice, caption, keywords.
- **PDF metadata**: Author name, organization/company, creation software, creation and modification dates, document title, subject, producer application.
- **Office document metadata (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX)**: Author name, revision history, company name, comments, tracked changes, last modified by.

---

## How It Works (Technical)

All processing runs exclusively in the user's browser. No files are transmitted to any server.

### Image Processing (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF)
- JPEG: Uses `piexifjs` to parse and zero-out all EXIF IFD blocks, then re-encodes using HTML5 Canvas `toBlob()` API.
- PNG: Re-drawn on Canvas without any tEXt, iTXt, or zTXt chunks.
- WebP/GIF: Processed via Canvas redraw to strip embedded metadata.

### PDF Processing
- Uses `pdf-lib` (WebAssembly-based) to load the PDF, clear `PDFDocument.setTitle('')`, `setAuthor('')`, `setSubject('')`, `setKeywords([])`, `setProducer('')`, `setCreator('')`, and save a fresh copy.

### Office Documents (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX)
- Uses `jszip` to unzip the Open XML container, locate `docProps/core.xml` and `docProps/app.xml`, strip all metadata fields, and re-zip the file for download.

---

## Privacy Guarantee

- **No server uploads**: Files are processed in-memory using browser JavaScript APIs.
- **No cookies** for tracking or profiling.
- **No analytics** that identify individual users.
- **No accounts** required.
- Files are automatically garbage-collected by the browser when the tab is closed.

## Site Structure

```
remover-metadados.com/
├── /                                    # PT-BR homepage + tool
├── /ver-metadados/                      # Online metadata & GPS inspector (PT-BR)
├── /blog/                               # Privacy & security blog hub (PT-BR)
│   ├── /como-ver-metadados-de-uma-foto/ # Guide: How to view photo metadata on mobile & PC
│   ├── /o-que-sao-metadados-exif-guia-completo/ # Guide: What is EXIF & GPS risks
│   └── /metadados-em-pdf-riscos-e-como-remover/ # Guide: PDF metadata & LGPD risks
├── /guias/                              # Privacy guides & tutorials hub (PT-BR)
│   ├── /remover-metadados-de-imagem/    # Photos & EXIF guide
│   ├── /remover-metadados-de-video/     # Videos & MP4/MOV guide
│   └── /remover-metadados-pdf/          # PDF & Office documents guide
├── /sobre                               # About us (PT-BR)
├── /privacidade                         # Privacy policy (PT-BR)
├── /termos                              # Terms of service (PT-BR)
├── /contato                             # Contact (PT-BR)
├── /en/                                 # EN homepage + tool
├── /en/metadata-viewer/                 # Online metadata & GPS inspector (EN)
├── /en/about                            # About us (EN)
├── /en/privacy                          # Privacy policy (EN)
├── /en/terms                            # Terms of service (EN)
├── /en/contact                          # Contact (EN)
├── /sitemap-index.xml                   # Sitemap index
├── /robots.txt                          # Crawler directives
├── /llms.txt                            # LLM summary
└── /llms-full.txt                       # This file
```

---

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Framework | Astro 7 (static site generation) |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 |
| Image metadata | piexifjs |
| PDF processing | pdf-lib |
| Office doc processing | jszip |
| Hosting target | Static CDN (Cloudflare Pages / Vercel / Netlify) |
| Languages | Portuguese (pt-BR), English (en) |
